description: A listing's verification template: output_schema, optional verification (rules, bounds, enforce_rules) and template_url. Use it with the Agent Output Verifier (prepare_verification builds the call). 404 no_template if the listing has none. Free, no payment or account required.

listing_id.description: The listing's id (a UUID), e.g. from search_listings.

name: get_template
title: Get a listing's output template
